description: Short stand-up: two explicit actions with owner and deadline, one decision, one vague 'someone should'.
transcript: Morning everyone, quick stand-up on the sensor firmware.
The bootloader update passed all twenty power-cut tests last night.
We agreed to ship version 1.4 to the pilot customers.
Carlos will tag the release candidate by Wednesday.
The flash wear numbers still look higher than expected.
Someone should look at the logging rate at some point.
Elena will send the wear report to the hardware team by Friday.
